summary: Implements published data tracks for RTC participants, including subscriber data downtrack creation, downtrack fanout, lifecycle closure, and data track statistics updates.
responsibilities: Expose published data track identity and protobuf metadata.
Create and remove subscriber-specific data downtracks.
Register and unregister data track senders for packet fanout.
Broadcast incoming data track packets to subscribed downtracks.
Track data packet statistics and close lifecycle state.

summary: Sentinel errors returned by published data track lifecycle operations.

variables.summary: Returned when a data downtrack is added after the published data track has closed.

summary: Represents one published data track and manages subscriber downtracks and packet fanout.

summary: Constructs a published data track with subscriber tracking, downtrack fanout, statistics, and an annotated logger.
summary_step: 1. Allocates a DataTrack with the supplied parameters, protobuf metadata, and an empty subscribed downtrack map.
2. Creates a logger annotated with the data track name and publication handle.
3. Builds a DownTrackSpreader for data track senders with a configured threshold and the annotated logger.
4. Creates the data track statistics collector using the same logger.
5. Logs the created data track metadata and returns the new DataTrack.

summary: Logs closure, breaks the closed fuse, and closes the data track statistics collector.
Returns the current publisher participant ID using the configured callback.
Returns the publisher identity configured for the data track.
Returns a cloned protobuf representation of the data track metadata.
Returns the publication handle from the data track metadata as a uint16.
Returns the published data track SID as a LiveKit track ID.
Returns the published data track name.
Creates and registers a subscriber-specific data downtrack for this published data track.
summary_step: 1. Locks the subscribed downtrack map and rejects duplicate subscriptions for the same subscriber participant ID.
2. Builds DataDownTrackParams using the subscriber logger, subscriber ID, publication handle, data track transport, and this published data track.
3. Creates the DataDownTrack and returns the creation error when registration fails.
4. Stores the created data downtrack by subscriber ID.
5. Returns the created data downtrack.

summary: Removes and closes the subscribed data downtrack for a subscriber when one exists.
summary_step: 1. Locks the subscribed downtrack map and reads the entry for the subscriber ID.
2. Deletes the subscriber entry from the map and unlocks.
3. Closes the removed data downtrack only when a matching subscription existed.

summary: Reports whether the participant ID currently has a subscribed data downtrack.
Registers a data track sender for packet fanout unless the published data track has closed.
summary_step: 1. Returns errReceiverClosed when the data track closed fuse has already been broken.
2. Logs when the fanout spreader already has a sender for the subscriber ID and will replace it.
3. Stores the supplied data track sender in the DownTrackSpreader.
4. Logs the added data downtrack and returns nil.

summary: Removes a data track sender from packet fanout for a subscriber and logs the deletion.
Updates data track statistics and broadcasts a received data packet to every registered data track sender.
summary_step: 1. Updates data track statistics with the packet metadata, arrival time, and raw payload length.
2. Broadcasts over the registered data track senders through the DownTrackSpreader.
3. Writes the packet data, packet metadata, and arrival time to each sender.
